name: fde
title_zh: 客户名一出现就自动记账的交付日志
tagline_zh: 客户名、会议记录、POC、上线、读稿，散在聊天和文档里，回头没人说得清当时答应了什么。
tagline_en: Client names, meeting notes, POCs, go-lives and readouts scattered across chats — it files them per client.
desc_en: Keeps the engagement record for client work. Use when they name a client or stakeholder. Use when they debrief a meeting or paste notes. Use when they ask what was agreed. Use when they run a POC, change the client's codebase, prove it on their staging, go live, or need evals before a model acts. Use when they prep a readout, when trust shifts, or they say @fde. Route and run the local fde CLI (or
why_zh: 不是笔记应用，是交付台账：按客户和干系人建账，会议、改代码、上线、模型上线前的评测都记进同一本。
why_en: Not a note app but an engagement ledger: per-client, per-stakeholder entries for meetings, code changes, go-lives and pre-model.
limit_zh: 只认本地 fde CLI，没有它整件跑不起来；记录只覆盖客户交付这一格，个人待办、内部项目它不管；产物是本地台账。
limit_en: Needs the local fde CLI or nothing runs; covers client delivery only, not personal todos or internal projects; output stays a local ledger, never.
title_en: A delivery log that files itself when a client is named
